meta.name: codex-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Codex Light edition (lazycodex / packages/omo-codex) itself, in strict isolation so ONLY our plugin is exercised, never the user's real ~/.codex. The first-party method drives the real `codex app-server` against an isolated CODEX_HOME plus a LOCAL mock model (no real API call), and proves a plugin hook fired by asserting hook/started + hook/completed notifications. Also: isolated install verification, per-component hook probes, a tmux TUI smoke, and runtime log observation (RUST_LOG / logs SQLite / /debug-config). Ships tested helper scripts each with a --self-test. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-codex or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Codex plugin, its hooks/components, the installer/config.toml, the app-server flow, or the Codex TUI. Triggers: codex qa, qa codex, codex-qa, test codex plugin, verify codex hook, codex app-server, lazycodex qa, isolated CODEX_HOME, prove codex hook fired, codex tui test.

copy.tagline: 在隔离环境中对 Codex 插件进行质量验证与冒烟测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要安全地测试 Codex 插件改动而不影响真实环境
copy.tagline_en: QA the Codex plugin in an isolated environment with smoke tests and hook verification
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to safely test Codex plugin changes without affecting your real environment

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你对 Codex 插件(lazycodex)做质量检查:在隔离的 CODEX_HOME 里跑自带脚本,验证插件钩子是否触发、安装是否成功、TUI 是否正常,并生成证据文件。整个过程不碰你真实的 ~/.codex,也不调用真实模型 API。
howto.when: 当你提到“codex qa”、“test codex plugin”、“verify codex hook”等关键词,或要求 QA、冒烟测试、验证、调试 Codex 插件及其组件、安装器或 app-server 流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我运行一次 codex-qa,验证插件钩子有没有触发。
用 install-verify 检查本地构建能不能装进隔离环境。
say.note: 会确认 config.toml 和组件链接。

say.text: 给 Codex TUI 做冒烟测试,截图留证据。
say.note: 通过 tmux 启动真实 TUI 并捕获画面。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude runs the bundled QA scripts for the Codex plugin in an isolated CODEX_HOME with a local mock model, verifying hooks fire, installs work, and the TUI boots, then saves evidence files. Your real ~/.codex is untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "codex qa", "test codex plugin", or "verify codex hook", or ask to QA, smoke-test, or debug the Codex plugin, its components, installer, app-server flow, or TUI.

say_en.text: Run codex-qa and verify the plugin hook fires.
say_en.note: Runs app-server-drive.sh in an isolated home.

say_en.text: Use install-verify to check the local build installs.
Smoke-test the Codex TUI and capture evidence.
say_en.note: Boots the real TUI via tmux.
